instruction: Create a security group in AWS
output: aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name my-sg --description "My SG" --vpc-id vpc-xxx

instruction: Authorize ingress in AWS security group
Create and attach an Internet Gateway in AWS
output: aws ec2 create-internet-gateway && aws ec2 attach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id igw-xxx --vpc-id vpc-xxx

instruction: Create a route table in AWS with internet access
output: aws ec2 create-route-table --vpc-id vpc-xxx && aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-xxx --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id igw-xxx

instruction: Allocate and associate an Elastic IP in AWS
output: aws ec2 allocate-address --domain vpc && aws ec2 associate-address --allocation-id eipalloc-xxx --instance-id i-xxx

instruction: Subscribe an email to SNS topic
output: aws sns subscribe --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:region:account:my-topic --protocol email --notification-endpoint user@example.com

instruction: Set up S3 static website hosting
output: aws s3 website s3://my-bucket --index-document index.html --error-document error.html
